# Feminist Majority Foundation

> The Feminist Majority Foundation is a comprehensive advocacy organization dedicated to advancing women's equality, reproductive justice, and global women's rights through policy, activism, and education.

Founded in 1987, the Feminist Majority Foundation (FMF) operates as a leading feminist advocacy organization focused on reproductive health access, the Equal Rights Amendment, violence prevention, education equity, and international women's rights. The organization combines grassroots activism, policy advocacy, historical documentation, and job placement services to advance feminist causes.

## Key Topics

- Reproductive Justice
- Equal Rights Amendment (ERA)
- Abortion Rights
- Violence Against Women
- Gender Apartheid
- Clinic Access
- Education Equity
- Global Women's Rights
- Feminist Activism
- Title IX
- Reproductive Health
- CEDAW
- Taliban
- Feminist Movement History
- Policy Advocacy

## Core Organization

- [Feminist Majority Foundation Homepage](https://feminist.org): FMF homepage: Organization dedicated to women's equality, reproductive health, and non-violence since 1987
- [Our Work](https://feminist.org/our-work): Overview of FMF's advocacy work including ERA, reproductive justice, and women's equality
- [Support FMF](https://feminist.org/support-fmf): Donation methods and charitable giving options for supporting FMF

## Reproductive Justice & Healthcare

- [Abortion](https://feminist.org/our-work/abortion): Abortion rights advocacy, healthcare access, and reproductive justice information
- [Mifepristone](https://feminist.org/our-work/mifepristone): Medical abortion information on mifepristone approval and reproductive health advocacy
- [Birth Control](https://feminist.org/our-work/birth-control): Contraception access advocacy and reproductive health policy information
- [National Clinic Access Project](https://feminist.org/our-work/national-clinic-access-project): Clinic safety, anti-abortion violence prevention, and reproductive health provider protection

## Rights & Advocacy Initiatives

- [Equal Rights Amendment](https://feminist.org/our-work/equal-rights-amendment): FMF's Equal Rights Amendment advocacy and ratification status information
- [Violence Against Women](https://feminist.org/our-work/violence-against-women): Violence Against Women Act advocacy, domestic violence, and sexual assault prevention
- [Education Equity](https://feminist.org/our-work/education-equity): Title IX enforcement, gender discrimination in education, and women in sports advocacy
- [Global Women's Rights](https://feminist.org/our-work/global-womens-rights): Global women's rights advocacy including CEDAW, FGM, and human trafficking
- [Stop Gender Apartheid in Afghanistan](https://feminist.org/our-work/afghan-women-and-girls): Campaign against gender apartheid in Afghanistan under Taliban rule

## News & Media

- [News](https://feminist.org/news): News and articles on women's rights, abortion access, voting rights, and feminist activism
- [Videos](https://feminist.org/media/videos): Video library featuring feminist issues, women's rights, and social justice documentaries
- [Afghanistan Faces Growing Crises](https://feminist.org/news/afghanistan-faces-converging-crises-as-aid-cuts-regional-conflict-and-diplomatic-uncertainty-deepen-civilian-suffering): News article on Afghanistan humanitarian crisis and women's rights under Taliban restrictions

## Historical Resources & Archives

- [The Feminist Chronicles, 1953-1993](https://feminist.org/resources/feminist-chronicles): Historical chronological resource documenting feminist movement from 1953-1993
- [Women's History Collections](https://feminist.org/resources/womens-history-collections): Primary sources, archives, and educational resources on women's history and feminist movement
- [Feminist Magazines](https://feminist.org/resources/feminist-magazines): Directory of feminist magazines including Ms. Magazine and other women's publications

## Community & Careers

- [Feminist Jobs](https://jobs.feminist.org): Job board for feminist organizations and progressive nonprofit careers
